title: GTA6 Era Approaches: Push Square Launches October 2026 PS5 GOTM Poll
description: Push Square has launched its PS5 Game of the Month poll for October 2026. Known as the month before GTA 6, October delivered a busy lineup of releases.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Month Before GTA 6: October's PS5 Lineup

As the gaming community eagerly anticipates the upcoming arrival of GTA 6, media outlets and players alike are reflecting on the milestones leading up to it. Recently, gaming website Push Square officially launched its latest Game of the Month (GOTM) poll for the PS5 platform, giving players the chance to decide October's standout title.

As noted by Push Square, October can aptly be described as "the month before GTA 6." Following an equally manic September, the past 31 days have been incredibly busy for new PS5 releases. This packed schedule of new titles makes the latest GOTM poll all the more intriguing, as players weigh a variety of experiences released during this transitional period.

## A Packed 31 Days of Releases

The sheer volume of games launching in a single month has created a fascinating landscape for PS5 owners. With publishers positioning their titles ahead of the monumental GTA 6 window, October proved to be anything but quiet. The diverse array of new releases means that competition for the Game of the Month title is fierce, capturing a snapshot of a very busy period for Sony's current-gen console.

Fans and community members can head over to Push Square to cast their votes and determine which release ultimately takes home the crown for October 2026.

## Editor's Take

October 2026 holds a unique place in the gaming calendar as the final major stretch before GTA 6 takes over the conversation. The fact that the month still delivered a packed lineup of busy PS5 releases is a testament to the platform's ongoing strength. This poll captures a fascinating moment in gaming history right before the next era begins.
